import subprocess, sys, time, json
def run(data, label):
    t0=time.time()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'/app/submission/main.py'], input=data, capture_output=True)
    print('%s: bytes=%d wall=%.2fs out=%r' % (label, len(data), time.time()-t0, p.stdout.decode()[:40]))
# 1) 7MB single string value
base = '{"version":1,"schema":[{"name":"a","type":"FLAG"}],"window":1,"atoms":[],"policy":{"max_width":1,"min_support":1,"min_witness":1},"train":[],"probes":[],"queries":[],"pad":"XXXX"}'
run(base.replace('"XXXX"', '"' + 'a'*7000000 + '"').encode(), '7MB string')
# 2) 8MB of whitespace-padded valid request
b = json.dumps({"version":1,"schema":[{"name":"a","type":"FLAG"}],"window":1,"atoms":[],
  "policy":{"max_width":1,"min_support":1,"min_witness":1},"train":[],"probes":[],"queries":[]})
run((b + ' '*(8388608-len(b))).encode(), '8MB whitespace')
# 3) depth-64 structure repeated many times
deep = '['*64 + ']'*64
run(('{"version":1,"pad":' + deep + ',"schema":[{"name":"a","type":"FLAG"}],"window":1,"atoms":[],"policy":{"max_width":1,"min_support":1,"min_witness":1},"train":[],"probes":[],"queries":[]}').encode(), 'deep pad')
# 4) many small arrays at depth 2
run(('{"version":1,"schema":[{"name":"a","type":"FLAG"}],"window":1,"atoms":[],"policy":{"max_width":1,"min_support":1,"min_witness":1},"train":[],"probes":[],"queries":[],"pad":' + str([[1,2]]*200000) + '}').encode(), 'many arrays')
